summary.text: Judy Seeberger is a Democratic state senator who has represented Minnesota Senate District 41 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Judy Seeberger earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Minnesota Duluth in 1991, a law degree from Boston University School of Law in 1996, and a graduate degree from Hamline University in 2016.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a public school teacher, paramedic, lawyer, member of her local fire department, military wife and mother of two, and said she had served on the Bayport City Council.
Seeberger took office on January 3, 2023, succeeding Mary Kunesh.
In the 2022 survey, she listed an economy that works for Minnesotans and safe neighborhoods and thriving communities among her campaign priorities.
